Support for Payload `4.0.0-beta.0`. `payload`, `@payloadcms/ui` and `@payloadcms/translations` now accept any Payload 4 version (`^4.0.0-0`), so you no longer need one exact canary. Keep all three on the same version.

Since Payload `4.0.0-canary.39`, a new upload that Payload doesn't change is stored as `<name>-original.<ext>`. The preview shows this stored name in the modal title and the download file name.

```bash
pnpm add @seshuk/payload-plugin-media-preview@beta
```
